plain_english_revision: The amendment modifies the eligibility requirements for unemployment benefits by adding a geographic condition. It stipulates that an individual must search for work at least once per week if they live within 45 miles of a Career Center, or at least one prospective employer if they reside more than 45 miles from such a center.
candidate_position_supported: The amendment supports restricting unemployment benefit eligibility based on the applicant's proximity to Career Centers. Specifically, it advances a policy requiring job search activity (one time per week) for residents within 45 miles of a Career Center or those with at least one prospective employer if living further away.
evidence_quotes: if he or she resides within 45 miles of a Career Center, or at least one prospective employer if he or she resides 45 miles or more from a Career Center
